$comment: Reviewed npm advisory exceptions for scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. An entry
here suppresses exactly one advisory ID and nothing else — the gate still
fails closed on every other high/critical, including new ones in the same
package. Adding an entry is a security decision: record why the advisory is
not exploitable here, and set `expires` to the date the reasoning must be
re-checked (an expired entry fails the build). Delete an entry as soon as
the gate reports it STALE — that means upstream shipped a fix.

advisories.reason: No upstream fix exists: bigint-buffer@1.1.5 is the latest published release and is itself the vulnerable one, reached only through @solana/spl-token -> @solana/buffer-layout-utils, both already at latest. The overflow is in the optional native addon's toBigIntLE/toBufferLE bindings; bigint-buffer maps dist/node.js -> dist/browser.js via its package.json browser field, and that build hard-codes the pure-JS BigInt/hex path with the converter call unreachable. Verified the web bundle carries no native path (no bindings loader in dist/assets). In solana/ it is off-chain deployment tooling that never ships in a program.
